KEN Rimba

KEN Rimba is the country’s first green township. Utilising many of KEN’s building philosophies such as wind-flow orientation and breathable roof system, the properties are built for comfortable and energy efficient living. Furthermore, KEN Rimba's properties have earned a host of local and regional awards in the green certification arena.

Menara KEN TTDI

Menara KEN TTDI is a multiple platinum award-winning green building. Building work life balance into its spaces and with space efficiency at the heart of its design, the tower features column-free office suites, event spaces, an art gallery and rooftop recreational facilities such as a gymnasium, swimming pool and a sky bar.

KEN Bangsar

Enjoy a private and serene stay at KEN Bangsar, a place you would be proud to call home. Situated on the top of Bukit Bandaraya in Bangsar, Kuala Lumpur, KEN Bangsar is a low density serviced residence which offers residents an exclusive residence with a beautiful view of the Kuala Lumpur.

KEN Museum
